articles.company_name: The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V.
articles.summary: Unilever PLC ("Unilever") today announces a revision to the timetable for the demerger of The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V. (the "Demerger") as a result of the ongoing US federal government shutdown. Read the full announcement here.
articles.title: Unilever Updates Demerger and Share Consolidation Timetable
